about.sectionTitle: A little about who I am
description: Full stack engineer with a strong focus on cloud-native infrastructure, distributed systems, and generative AI capabilities. Spent recent years architecting analytics platforms, automated data ingestion pipelines, and specialized LLM assistant integrations.

Work spans the entire delivery spectrum — from frontend web components in React and lightweight Alpine.js forms to containerized microservices, OpenTofu infrastructure provisioning, and custom forecasting algorithms in Python.

skills.sectionTitle: What I bring to the table

tags: AWS (EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway)

description: Developed React + TypeScript frontend components for an analytics dashboard platform, including interactive chart widgets, filter panels, and shared public dashboard access with correct HTMX fragment loading and widget refresh on state change.

Built and maintained Jenkins CI/CD pipelines covering lint, unit tests, Docker build, ECR push, and Helm upgrade stages; ran pipeline agents as dynamic EKS pods to eliminate standing CI infrastructure.

Extended OpenTofu (Terraform) IaC to provision DynamoDB, S3 buckets, SQS queues, RDS, and Secrets Manager resources; wired External Secrets Operator to sync AWS Secrets Manager into Kubernetes native secrets.
Identified and closed an unauthenticated API endpoint leaking widget data; hashed OAuth client secrets at rest and wrote integration tests validating constant-time secret comparison.

Built automated data ingestion pipelines using Dagster processing financial data daily from QuickBooks, Google Sheets, HubSpot, SAP, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Infor Syteline and email attachments, reducing data delivery time from manual uploads to fully automated ingestion.

Designed parameterized SQL models covering Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, P&L, budget vs actual and period-over-period analysis that served 15+ clients from a single template, cutting per-client onboarding time by 90%.

Set up performance-oriented database design in PostgreSQL with indexed queries, connection pooling via RDS Proxy, and pgvector for semantic search workloads. Monitored query performance and addressed bottlenecks before they showed up in production dashboards.

Containerized every service with multi-stage Dockerfiles and deployed to AWS EKS using Helm charts with Karpenter autoscaling. Separate node pools handle web traffic, data pipeline jobs, and AI workloads so slow job does not affect the application.

Refactored two multi-step Django SessionWizardMixin flows (organization creation and data source creation) into Alpine.js forms, removing server-side wizard state and cutting form completion round trips to a single request.
Built a Dockerfile and Python runner builder image with uv baked in, removing all runtime curl installs and standardizing the Python execution environment across CI and production.

Built tool integrations for Aimee, LLM-powered chat assistant (LangGraph + claude Opus 4.8), exposing forecasting and anomaly detection capabilities through the AimeeToolRegistry. Tools allowed Aimee to discover available algorithms, execute them against live widget data through the engine and read back saved results.
Led the migration of the AI tool layer to a FastMCP-based Model Context Protocol server, a standardized architecture for LLM tool discovery and execution.

Built Moving Average forecasting and 5 time-series anomaly detection algorithms (STL decomposition, ARIMA residuals, Exponential Smoothing, CUSUM, EWMA) as a standalone Python microservice with algorithm registry, Django views, JavaScript chart renderers, feature flag gating and 106 test cases covering full stack integration.

Successfully integrated an AI-powered assistant into the ticket management tool, leveraging RAG with Llama 3.1 and testing on 47,000 historical tickets, increasing helpdesk ticket resolution speed by 30%.
Reduced helpdesk response time by 25% by implementing a real-time LLM system with Hugging Face embeddings, Pinecone vector databases, and Groq, optimizing ticket analysis and automation.

Set up Nginx as a reverse proxy on a HIPAA-compliant healthcare project, Dockerized and deployed to AWS ECR, reducing server response time by 40% and standardizing environments across dev and production.
Developed Flask REST APIs using Boto3 to transfer data between AWS S3 and Edge/Device VMs; implemented token-based auth on AWS API Gateway, reducing unauthorized access attempts by 80%.
Configured AWS Route 53 and API Gateway custom domains; leveraged CloudWatch dashboards for API Gateway and reverse proxy metrics, reducing system downtime by 30%.
